- **Monitor Burn Rate:** Continue monitoring the burn rate to ensure it remains sustainable and adjust strategies as needed to maintain efficiency.
- **Capacity Management:** Regularly assess team capacity and workload distribution to prevent future sprints from being under-delivered.
